title: unified-rollouts: add canary + A/B + shadow traffic controller with automated rollback
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: unify canary, A/B tests, and shadow traffic into a single rollouts controller with a declarative policy language and automated rollback based on observable regressions. This PR implements the controller runtime, API changes, Console editor, CI/e2e tests, and monitoring hooks. Key behaviors: 1) new RolloutPolicy resource supports strategies: canary, ab, shadow; 2) step-based canary with weight ramps and metric gates (latency_p95, error_rate, model_quality_score); 3) automated rollback when configured gates breach for N consecutive windows; 4) shadow traffic mode to mirror 100% traffic to a variant for offline evaluation; 5) A/B partitioning support with statistical evaluation hooks for conversion metrics. Backwards compatibility: supports existing legacy rollout config and migrates on read; no breaking API changes by default. Implementation notes: controller runs as part of services/rollout; health evaluator consults observability/metrics and decides promote/rollback; rollout decisions emit events and metrics under rollout.*. Example policy snippet included in docs and examples: "rollout_policy: {strategy: canary, steps: [{duration: 10m, weight: 10}, {duration: 20m, weight: 50}], metric_gates: [{name: \"error_rate\", threshold: 0.01, operator: lt}] }". The description below lists high-level file changes and commit summary. Manual testing performed locally and via CI, e2e suite, and a staged deployment on dev cluster.
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) initial unified controller + API and storage migration; (2) metrics/health evaluator + automated rollback logic; (3) console editor, docs, e2e tests and CI updates
review_comments: Evelyn: requested clearer metric gating semantics and perf test for high QPS; Samir: asked to expose metric windows and consecutive failure windows as config, flagged one race in promotion path; Liam: asked for docs on migration and default behavior. Author response: addressed gating docs, added metric window config, fixed race by serializing promotion updates, added e2e test for ramping and automatic rollback. All reviewers approved after fixes. CI initially failed e2e due to timing flakiness; fixed by tuning test harness and rerunning, all checks green.
tests_summary: unit: 124 passed; e2e: initial run flakey (timeout in canary ramp test), fixed timing and retried; e2e final: 18/18 passed; load tests: small local run shows p95 within SLO under expected traffic, will schedule larger soak on staging
release_notes: Add unified rollouts controller supporting canary, A/B, and shadow strategies; declarative RolloutPolicy API; automated metric-gated rollback; Console editor for rollouts; example configs and migration tooling; observability metrics and alerts for rollouts; rollout feature flag gated for gradual enablement
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: automated rollback could trigger noisy rollbacks if metrics are noisy; mitigation: default conservative gates, consecutive window count defaulted to 3, can be disabled per-rollout; rollout feature flag + staged rollout to disable globally; added audit events and manual override endpoint; e2e and canary soak on staging before enabling for customers
quality_gates: Added rollout_regression_alert (observability/metrics/rollout_alerts.yaml) and health_evaluator test coverage; automated rollback toggle controlled via rollout_policy. Metric gates: error_rate, latency_p95, model_quality_score are supported out of the box.
notes_for_ops: Helm values added to infra/helm/rollouts-values.yaml for autoscaling and controller tuning; migration script scripts/rollout_migrations/0002_unified_rollouts.sql must be run for DB-backed clusters during deploy; added docs/docs/rollouts.md with migration steps and rollback troubleshooting
examples: examples/unified-rollouts/sample-config.yaml demonstrates canary, A/B, and shadow configs; Console UI changes in web/console include a RolloutEditor for policy authoring
changelog_entry: feature: unified rollouts controller (canary, A/B, shadow) with automated rollback [#24612]
manual_steps: 1) run DB migration scripts/rollout_migrations/0002_unified_rollouts.sql against metadata DB; 2) deploy services/rollout with new helm values; 3) enable feature flag 'unified_rollouts' in infra/helm/rollouts-values.yaml for target clusters; 4) verify metrics and alerts in staging before enabling in prod
ci_pipeline: ci/pipeline-rollouts.yml integrates unit, e2e, and a lightweight canary emulation job; pipeline marks rollback behavior as gated test
follow_up_tasks: ENG-5489: add canary analytics dashboard; ENG-5497: integrate statistical significance tests for A/B rollout decisions; PM-334: define default model_quality_score evaluation; SRE-202: run staged soak on staging for 72h
notes: This PR is the canonical rollout runtime used by Hosted and Dedicated; Private deployments require running the DB migration during the upgrade window. Contact serving-runtime on-call for rollout incidents.
